purpose: Teach: 譴/發/ココログ/茲/兇/廚/李/眞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、譴責で済んだ社員も後に大成された
lines.en: Dad, even employees he had to reprimand in those early days — many of them went on to do great things.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. The voice of someone drawing on decades of memory. Warm approval in the delivery. Slight lift at the end — pride, not boasting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは旧字「發」の登記簿を大事に保管された
lines.en: Yes. Father kept the old-form character 發 in our registration very carefully.
lines.style: Respectful, almost reverent. Each phrase deliberate. A quiet acknowledgment of his father's attention to tradition and detail. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、ココログで社員と交流された
lines.en: Dad, when he was younger, he used to connect with the staff through Cocolog.
lines.style: Softer now, nostalgic. The voice travels back in time. A small smile underneath — affection for a father's unexpected habit. Slightly wondering, like he's seeing him clearly again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは式典で「茲に」と仰る方だった
lines.en: Yes. Father was the kind of man who would say 茲に — that formal, deliberate way — even at ceremonies.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to himself. A small affectionate recognition. The cadence is exact, measured — he's picturing his father's manner of speaking. Warm beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、兇器持つ事は許されなかった
lines.en: Dad, in his younger years, he would never have permitted himself to carry weapons.
lines.style: Quiet and steady. The voice of someone stating a principle his father lived by. No judgment — just clear understanding. A pause after the opening, as if considering the weight of that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員食堂の廚房、つまり厨房を毎日見回られた
lines.en: Yes. Father walked through the kitchen of the staff cafeteria every single day.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. A detail observed with care. The tone carries the repetition — every day — as a small act of presence and oversight. Not stern, but attentive. Quiet pride in the detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、李社長との合弁を成功された
lines.en: Dad, in those earlier years, he successfully negotiated the joint venture with President Li.
lines.style: Nostalgic again, but with an edge of accomplishment. The voice settles on 「成功」 with quiet satisfaction. A breath underneath — the memory of a significant achievement. Still tender, but with steel.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業者眞太郎様の遺志を継がれた
lines.en: Yes. Father carried on the legacy of Shintaro, our founder, with his whole heart.
lines.style: Reverent close. The final statement. Weight in every syllable. A man speaking of inheritance both of principle and responsibility. Slow, almost ceremonial. The voice honours both generations.
